d: Job Category Food and Beverage & Culinary
Location Sheikh Khalifa Bin Salman Highway, Al Seef District, Manama, BahrainVIEW ON MAP

Our jobs aren’t just about mixing drinks. Instead, we want to build an experience that is memorable and unique. Our bartenders have the basics down, but are constantly on the look-out for new trends, micro-local offerings, and guests’ evolving needs. They are not just a beverage enthusiast, but also the host of the space. Their role goes beyond the bar itself to take ownership of guest service more broadly and do what needs to be done. Bartenders will use their knowledge and expertise to make the bar look and function flawlessly. They will build relationships with others across the hotel and in the community, to anticipate and deliver on our guests’ needs. They should be passionate about the guest service experience, but also have an eye for detail – from the money that moves through their hands, to the information they provide to guests, to the quality of their drinks.

No matter what position you are in, there are a few things that are critical to success – creating a safe workplace, following company policies and procedures, protecting company assets, maintaining confidentiality, and ensuring your uniform and personal appearance are professional. Bartenders will be on their feet and moving around (stand, sit, or walk for an extended period of time) and taking a hands-on approach to their work (move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 25 pounds without assistance; reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping). Doing all these things well (and other reasonable job duties as requested) is critical for Bartenders – to get it right for our guests and our business each and every time.
q: Education: High school diploma or G.E.D. equivalent.
Related Work Experience: At least 1 year of related work experience.

في ويستن، نحن ملتزمون بتمكين الضيوف من استعادة السيطرة وتعزيز رفاهيتهم عندما يكونون في أمس الحاجة إليها أثناء السفر، مما يضمن قدرتهم على أن يكونوا أفضل نسخة من أنفسهم. لتحقيق مهمة العلامة التجارية المتمثلة في أن تصبح العلامة التجارية الرائدة في مجال العافية في مجال الضيافة، نحتاج إلى شركاء متحمسين ومشاركين لإضفاء الحيوية على البرامج الفريدة للعلامة التجارية. نريد أن يتبنى شركاؤنا ممارسات الرفاهية الخاصة بهم داخل وخارج الممتلكات. أنت المرشح المثالي لويستن إذا كنت متحمسًا؛ أنت نشط وتفخر بكيفية الحفاظ على رفاهيتك؛ أنت متفائل؛ أنت مغامر. كن في المكان الذي يمكنك فيه القيام بأفضل أعمالك، وابدأ هدفك ، وانتمي إلى فريق عالمي مذهل ، لتصبح أفضل نسخة منك.

d: The Manager – Finance Operations will be embedded within the City Operations Finance & Control team, providing dedicated finance operations, contract and commercial support to the Workers accommodation team

The role will manage the day-to-day invoice validation and processing, contract administration, commercial documentation and reporting for Workers Village contractors and service providers. Working closely with the Workers Village team, Finance & Control and suppliers, the role will ensure contractor charges are appropriately validated, supported, approved and processed through the Horizon system, with clear visibility of outstanding actions, risks and payments.
As Workers Village activity and contractor volumes grow, the role will provide the dedicated commercial and financial control needed to support effective operations.
q: 8+ years' relevant experience across finance operations, commercial management, contract administration, invoicing or related roles.
Strong experience managing contractor invoicing, validation, approvals and payment processes, ideally in a high-volume operational environment.
Experience supporting large operational/service contracts, preferably within workforce accommodation, FM, O&M, hospitality, infrastructure or similar environments.
Good understanding of contracts and commercial terms, with the ability to validate supplier charges against contractual rates, supporting documentation and operational data.
Experience dealing with volume-based or activity-based billing, such as man-days, headcount, unit rates, service volumes or similar charging mechanisms.
Strong reporting and analytical capability, including maintaining invoice/payment trackers, reconciliations, ageing analysis and management reporting.
Experience with ERP/procure-to-pay systems, ideally Horizon, PRISM, Ariba or equivalent, together with strong Excel skills.
Strong attention to detail and a controls-focused mindset, with the ability to identify discrepancies and resolve issues proactively.
Experience within Saudi Arabia/GCC and complex operational environments would be advantageous.
Bachelor’s degree in finance, Accounting, Business, Commercial Management, Contract Management or a related discipline.
Relevant Finance, Commercial, Procurement or Contract Management professional qualification would be advantageous.
r: li
Manage contractor invoicing end-to-end, from receipt and validation through approval, Horizon processing and payment tracking.
li
Validate invoices against contractual terms and supporting operational data, including contractor man-days, agreed rates and relevant service information.
li
Lead invoice processing through the Horizon system, ensuring submissions are complete, accurate and supported by the required documentation and approvals.
li
Manage invoice queries and discrepancies, working directly with contractors, vendors, Workers Village and Finance teams to drive timely resolution.
li
Support contract administration, including preparation and review of contracts, RoUs, supporting schedules and other commercial documentation.
li
Coordinate commercial and financial approvals, ensuring the appropriate justification, documentation and governance requirements are in place.
li
Maintain clear contract, invoice and payment trackers, proactively following up outstanding actions and escalating material issues.
li
Provide regular management reporting on invoice volumes, payment status, ageing, contract status, risks and key actions.
li
Act as a key coordination point between Workers Village, Finance & Control, wider internal functions, contractors and vendors on invoicing and contract matters.
li
Maintain robust financial controls and audit trails, ensuring contract and payment documentation is complete and readily available.
li
Support the Senior Manager and Directors with commercial analysis, contract matters, reporting and ad-hoc requirements relating to Workers Village operations.
li
Help improve and standardize invoicing, contract administration and reporting processes as Workers Village operations continue to scale.
